A ablation study (mean ± sd over 5 seeds) is a statistical method used to study the effects of different variables on a system. It is a common technique in research to understand how different factors affect a system. The study involves measuring the effects of each variable on a system, such as the number of seeds, temperature, or other variables. The study is often repeated to see how the variables affect each other.
